text:
Dana Voss: heads-up: our staging sample app is noisy with schema parse errors after the new streaming fncall path. appears JSON-mode stream emits fragmentary tokens and the validator runs per chunk.
Kai Zhang: can you paste a snippet? this usually shows a partial JSON token across events.
Dana Voss: snippet from staging: 
[data] '{\"call\":{\"name\":\"ingest\",\"args\":{\"docs\":['
[data] '\"one\",\"two\"'
[data] ']}}'
validator: SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
Rina Patel: yep, the SDK attempts to parse every data event. streaming yields fragments. short-term we should ship an SDK helper to assemble a top-level JSON object before validation.
Kai Zhang: agreed. proposal: a helper named `streamJsonGuard` (keeps parity across SDKs). semantics: collect until top-level braces/brackets balance, then emit {type: 'complete', payload: string}. if limits hit, emit {type: 'partial', payload: string, truncated: true}. defaults: maxBytes=100*1024, maxWaitMs=180.
Dana Voss: add an option `emitTokensImmediately` so UI apps can render tokens while the helper assembles the full object in parallel. important for low-latency experiences.
Rina Patel: tests must include escaped braces inside strings, nested arrays, NDJSON inside tool outputs, and concatenated JSON objects. include fuzzing for random chunk boundaries.
Kai Zhang: parity: implement identical API for node and python (async iterator/generator) and keep same helper name. document behavior in sampleapp onboarding and show fallback to non-streaming call when partial truncated events occur.
Dana Voss: infra note: watch out for retries triggering duplicate validator runs; make validation idempotent or dedupe per request-id. also add telemetry keys `sdk.streamjsonguard.bytes`, `sdk.streamjsonguard.latency_ms`, `sdk.streamjsonguard.mode` so we can tune defaults after rollout.
Rina Patel: I'll prototype TS helper and unit tests behind a feature flag. Kai will implement python mirror and add integration test in sampleapp harness.
ops-bot: created issue #9751 "streamJsonGuard: SDK streaming JSON assembler + parity + telemetry" assigned Rina/Kai.
Dana Voss: checklist: unit tests, node+py parity, sampleapp docs update, telemetry, feature flag. aiming to land draft PR tomorrow.
Kai Zhang: will add idempotency guard for validator and a CI lint that runs sampleapp in both stream and non-stream modes.
Rina Patel: thanks team, will post PR link in this thread when ready for review.
